tool_input.command:
Write-Host "=== LARGEST DIRECTORIES (AppData & common locations) ===" 

$dirs = @(
    @{ Path = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\npm-cache"; Name = "npm cache" },
    @{ Path = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\pip"; Name = "pip cache" },
    @{ Path = "$env:APPDATA\npm"; Name = "npm config" },
    @{ Path = "$env:USERPROFILE\AppData\Local\Temp"; Name = "Temp files" },
    @{ Path = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer"; Name = "Windows Explorer cache" },
    @{ Path = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Microsoft\Edge"; Name = "Edge browser cache" },
    @{ Path = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Google\Chrome"; Name = "Chrome cache" },
    @{ Path = "$env:APPDATA\Mozilla\Firefox"; Name = "Firefox cache" }
)

$dirs | Where-Object { Test-Path $_.Path } | ForEach-Object {
    try {
        $size = (Get-ChildItem $_.Path -Recurse -File -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum).Sum
        if ($size -gt 0) {
            Write-Host "$('{0:N0}' -f ($size / 1MB)) MB - $($_.Name)`n  Location: $($_.Path)"
        }
    } catch { }
}

Write-Host "`n=== SAFE CLEANUP OPTIONS ===" 
Write-Host @"
1. Pip cache (safe to clear):
   rm -r '$env:LOCALAPPDATA\pip\http' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
   
2. npm cache (can be rebuilt):
   npm cache clean --force
   
3. Temp files (old temporary files):
   Remove-Item -Path '$env:TEMP\*' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
   
4. Windows Update cache (safe if Windows is fully updated):
   Disk Cleanup tool → Windows Update Cleanup

5. Check for duplicate/leftover files from tools:
   Get-ChildItem $env:USERPROFILE -Name '*.tmp' -Recurse -Force
"@
